• Analyse the problem behaviors and understand patterns : time of occurance, triggers, 
duration and consequencies
• Engage with child in mutually enjoyable, pleasurable activities (playing games, 
discussing interesting things or doing activities together)
• Set clear do’s and don’ts and explain to child in clear, simple, short instructions the 
consequencies (like withholding privileges following misbehavior; use star-charting 
(contingency management) and rewards based on number of stars earned
• In children with ADHD, develop clear daily routines, supervise activities and appreciate 
on completion of taks
